previous_disclosures.summary: Citi has ended nearly all institutional banking services in Russia, retaining only those necessary to meet legal and regulatory obligations, while also significantly reducing its consumer loan portfolio in the region. The company has ceased soliciting new business or clients in Russia and is managing existing commitments and supporting employees during this wind-down period.

current_disclosures.summary: Citi ended nearly all institutional banking services in Russia and ceased new business solicitations, retaining only services required for legal, regulatory, and employee support obligations.
Citi significantly reduced its consumer loan portfolio in Russia through portfolio sales and a credit card referral agreement with a Russian bank.

Citi's remaining Russia operations are conducted through Services, Markets, Banking and All Other-Legacy Franchises, with ongoing monitoring of the war in Ukraine, sanctions, and economic conditions to mitigate exposures.

comparisons.peer_topic: Strategic narrowing of consumer activities via divestitures and transitions
comparisons.peer_summary: Goldman Sachs narrowed its focus on consumer-related activities in 2023 and 2024 by completing the sale of the Marcus loan portfolio, its PFM business, and the majority of the GreenSky loan portfolio, as well as selling its seller financing loan portfolio. In 2024, the company also agreed to transition the GM credit card program to another issuer, expected to complete in Q3 2025, while committing to support products and customers during these transitions.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs engaged in strategic portfolio reductions and wind-downs of specific consumer or franchise activities in 2024, utilizing sales and transitions. Citi significantly reduced its Russia consumer loan portfolio through sales and a referral agreement, while Goldman Sachs narrowed its consumer focus by completing the sale of the Marcus loan portfolio, the majority of the GreenSky loan portfolio, and its seller financing loan portfolio, as well as transitioning the GM credit card program.

sentences.text: In addition, Citi significantly reduced its All Other-Legacy Franchises consumer loan portfolio in Russia (reported as part of Asia Consumer), largely due to loan portfolio sales and its entry into a credit card referral agreement with a Russian bank.
• We completed the sale of substantially all of the Marcus loan portfolio in 2023 (included within Asset & Wealth Management).
• We sold the majority of the GreenSky loan portfolio in 2023 and, during 2024, completed the sale of GreenSky (included within Platform Solutions).

• During 2024, we entered into an agreement to transition the GM credit card program (included within Platform Solutions) to another issuer. The transition is expected to be completed in the third quarter of 2025.
• During 2024, we sold our seller financing loan portfolio (included within Platform Solutions). This portfolio consisted of loans that were extended to small- and medium-sized retailers.
